news.title: Bering Land Bridge base camp reveals what life was like nearly 14,000 years ago
news.summary_en: In a new article, Kelly Graf, professor of anthropology at the University of Kansas, highlights the research her team did excavating an early base camp in Beringia from 13,800 years ago, revealing important information about late-glacial peopling and settling-in behavior in this far northern setting.

news.title: Governor will speak at KU’s 50th annual Kansas Economic Policy Conference
news.summary_en: State lawmakers, experts and policymakers will convene at the University of Kansas for its 50th Kansas Economic Policy Conference. The 2026 event on Oct. 29 will address the “Future of the Kansas Economy,” with a talk by Kansas Gov. Laura Kelly.

news.title: KU Law professor writes book on negotiation skills
news.summary_en: Stephen Ware, a University of Kansas professor of law, has written the book “Principles of Negotiation, Mediation, and Other Processes of Dispute Resolution,” a book aimed at helping law students and practitioners understand how to negotiate, the different approaches and why it’s a vital skill.

news.title: KU presentation will share story of Lawrence native, Met Opera singer Beatrice Belkin
news.summary_en: A University of Kansas faculty member’s Nov. 8 discussion will trace how a Jewish teenager’s early years in Lawrence led to the Met stage.

news.title: Bales Choral Society to perform with professional vocal ensemble
news.summary_en: The KU Bales Choral Society will join Prometheus: An American Vocal Consort for “A People United: The Human Spirit in Song” on Oct. 22 at the Lied Center of Kansas.

news.title: Gerri Berendzen to give Budig Writing Lecture on the value of revision in the age of AI
news.summary_en: Gerri Berendzen, lecturer in the William Allen White School of Journalism & Mass Communications and coordinator of the Bremner Editing Center, will present “When Writing and Editing Meet: The Growing Value of Revision” at 2 p.m. Nov. 2.

news.title: Dean Carol Smith elected to Association of Research Libraries board of directors
news.summary_en: KU Libraries Dean Carol Smith was elected to the 2027 board of directors of the Association of Research Libraries during the association’s fall meeting in Alexandria, Virginia. She will begin her three-year term Jan. 1, 2027.

news.title: KU Engineering to host 58th Annual Geotechnical Engineering Conference
news.summary_en: On Nov. 12, the University of Kansas Department of Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering will host experts in the field of geotechnical engineering for a conference exploring the latest developments in the field.

news.title: KU launches Higher Learning Commission Accreditation 2029 mid-cycle review
news.summary_en: In a little more than two years, the University of Kansas will undergo evaluation by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) to verify the institution continues to meet accreditation standards. On Oct. 6, members from various KU campuses met in the Kansas Union to formally begin the process.
